slides.h: EVERY DAY COULD BE THE DAY
slides.body: The goldfish wishes everyone a happy birthday every morning. Statistically it is always someone's. Accuracy through volume.
Buy a cake on the 1st. If nobody's birthday shows up by the 30th, the cake was yours all along. This system has no losers.
That cold feeling at 11PM? That is the calendar app of the soul. Send the wish now. Add 'sorry, network issues.'
The goldfish forgot your birthday, its own birthday, and this sentence. It is at peace. Be the goldfish.
Send this to the friend whose wishes always land a day late.
